Black—Victini and Reshiram }} '''Eindoak Town''' (Japanese: '''アイントオーク''' ''Eindoak'') is a location in the [[Unova]] [[region]] found somewhere between [[Castelia City]] and [[Nimbasa City]]. It is one of the settings of [[M14|''White—Victini and Zekrom'' and ''Black—Victini and Reshiram'']]. It is the relocated home of the "People of the Vale". Long ago, the [[Kingdom of the Vale]] engaged in a war that caused a disturbance in the force that kept the land alive and flourishing, the [[Dragon Force]]. Left with no other option, the [[King of the People of the Vale]] lifted the [[Sword of the Vale]] from the ground, and placed it atop a nearby mountain to ease the Dragon Force's fury. The People of the Vale then began anew, and over time, they erected a village situated along the mountain ridge, where many have come to live. The town now boasts bountiful orchards that supply the town with food. ==In animation== {{Ash}}, {{an|Iris}}, and {{an|Cilan}} ventured to Eindoak Town on their travels, wanting to participate in Eindoak Town's Harvest Festival battle tournament. On their way, Ash saved a pair of {{p|Deerling}} from falling off a cliff with the help of {{OBP|Victini|M14}}. Ash managed to get back to his friends through a cavern located near the bottom of the castle. Here he would later find the [[Dark Stone]]{{tt|*|Pokémon The Movie: White—Victini and Zekrom}}/[[Light Stone]]{{tt|*|Pokémon The Movie: Black—Victini and Reshiram}}. As soon as the trio reunited, they found their way to the battle tournament, with a little help from [[Damon]]. Victini secretly followed close behind them and it secretly powered up {{AP|Tepig}} and {{AP|Scraggy}}, allowing Ash to win some of his battles. [[Carlita]] realized this source of power, and the group were then properly introduced to Victini. Later, the Mayor of the town, [[Mannes]], told Ash, Iris, and Cilan the history of Eindoak Town and how it came to be. That evening, Damon announced his plan to relocate the Sword of the Vale back to its original location with the help of Victini and {{OBP|Reshiram|M14}}{{tt|*|Pokémon The Movie: White—Victini and Zekrom}}/{{OBP|Zekrom|M14}}{{tt|*|Pokémon The Movie: Black—Victini and Reshiram}}. The descendants of the People of the Vale agreed to this plan, and they allowed Damon to move the Sword of the Vale against Victini's will. This caused the dormant Dragon Force beneath Eindoak to erupt and split the earth into fractions. When the Sword of the Vale was relocated to its new location next to the ocean, Eindoak still remained unharmed, however now without the Sword of the Vale. Eindoak Town made a brief reappearance in ''[[M20|I Choose You!]]'', which is set in a timeline different from the main series. File:Eindoak Town 2.png|Streets of Eindoak Town File:Sword of the Vale inside.png|Sword of the Vale, the ancient castle File:Sword of the Vale.png|Sword of the Vale castle being reactivated ==In the games== [[File:DW Pokémon Movie.png|thumb|250px|Inside the Pokémon Movie home]] The home Pokémon Movie was made available to players for a specific duration. Inside are Pokémon present in the movie, as well as a Victini {{pkmn|doll}}. Players may view a trailer in the movie in the area they arrive in, or go to the Sword of the Vale. By tucking in Reshiram or Zekrom from a Pokémon event, players can access a new area in the [[Island of Dreams]] and play a game with a Victini waiting there. Completing the game once allows them to unlock a promotion that allows them to obtain a [[C-Gear]] skin featuring one of the two Pokémon – the one they tucked in, specifically. ==Trivia== * Eind was used as the [[Original Trainer|OT]] of Japanese or Korean [[Eind Victini|Victini]] distributed locally in 2011, a reference to the fourteenth movie {{OBP|Victini|M14}}'s appearance in Eindoak Town. ===Origin=== {{main|Pokémon world in relation to the real world#In the movies|Pokémon world in relation to the real world → In the movies}} Eindoak Town is inspired by various locations in {{wp|France}}. Tourrettes-sur-Loup) on the Pokémon movie website ([https://web.archive.org/web/20110603074820/http://www.pokemon-movie.jp/rokehan/03.html archived]) (Japanese), {{wp|Èze}}2011 France Location Scouting Report (Chapter 6: To Èze, the Most Famous Eagle's Nest Village) on the Pokémon movie website ([https://web.archive.org/web/20110603075348/http://www.pokemon-movie.jp/rokehan/06.html archived]) (Japanese), {{wp|Monaco}} and {{wp|Roquebrune-Cap-Martin}}2011 France Location Scouting Report (Chapter 7: To the Castle of Roquebrune-Cap-Martin) on the Pokémon movie website ([https://web.archive.org/web/20110603074510/http://www.pokemon-movie.jp/rokehan/07.html archived]) (Japanese)2011 France Location Scouting Report (Chapter 8: A Breathtaking View) on the Pokémon movie website ([https://web.archive.org/web/20110603074407/http://www.pokemon-movie.jp/rokehan/08.html archived]) (Japanese), {{wp|Sainte-Agnès, Alpes-Maritimes|Sainte-Agnès}}, {{wp|Peillon}}, and {{wp|Cagnes-sur-Mer}}2011 France Location Scouting Report (Chapter 9: Sainte-Agnès, Peillon, and Cagnes-sur-Mer) on the Pokémon movie website ([https://web.archive.org/web/20110603074346/http://www.pokemon-movie.jp/rokehan/09.html archived]) (Japanese) in southeastern France, as well as the {{wp|Mont-Saint-Michel Abbey|abbey}} on the tidal island of {{wp|Mont-Saint-Michel}}2011 France Location Scouting Report (Chapter 13: View from the Sky) on the Pokémon movie website ([https://web.archive.org/web/20110603075335/http://www.pokemon-movie.jp/rokehan/13.html archived]) (Japanese)2011 France Location Scouting Report (Chapter 14: The Iconic Mont-Saint-Michel) on the Pokémon movie website ([https://web.archive.org/web/20110603075842/http://www.pokemon-movie.jp/rokehan/14.html archived]) (Japanese) located in {{wp|Normandy}} in northwestern France. Director Yuyama noted that they sought out for sites where the castle and the village blend seamlessly together by the mountainside, taking inspiration from the medieval walled villages atop rocky hills referred to as "{{wp|Village perché|Eagle's Nest}}" in Gourdon, Èze, Sainte-Agnès, and Peillon.
